title: AdvancedChatCore Reforged
description: Core library and chat framework for the AdvancedChat module suite — required by the other AdvancedChat mods. Refurbished Minecraft 26.x version of DarkKronicle AdvancedChatCore.
body:
# AdvancedChatCore Reforged

AdvancedChatCore is the core library and chat framework that the rest of the AdvancedChat suite builds on.

> **Unofficial fork.** This is a community-maintained continuation of DarkKronicle's *AdvancedChat* suite (which its author archived), updated to **Minecraft 26.1 and 26.2** (Java 25). It is **not affiliated with, nor endorsed by, DarkKronicle**, and is distributed under the original project's MPL-2.0 license.

## Features

- Shared chat pipeline, configuration and GUI framework for the AdvancedChat suite
- Required by the other AdvancedChat Reforged modules

## Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.x** or **26.2** on **Java 25**
- [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) 0.19+, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) (sakura-ryoko 26.x builds)

## Source & license

[GitHub](https://github.com/flyingfinger1/AdvancedChatCore) · MPL-2.0 · original mod by DarkKronicle
